finding: v2 proves origin/integrity of head and credential attestations but does not prove freshness. A previously signed HEAD_ATTESTATION remains acceptable after authoritative head movement. Credential attestations have no expiry/revocation epoch. Authorization expiry is evaluated against caller-supplied now_iso, allowing clock rollback by an untrusted caller.
repair_boundary: Evaluation must derive current head and time from platform-owned registry state, not caller input. Head/credential/authorization attestations must bind a monotonic authority epoch; current-authority records from an older epoch must fail closed. Credential expiry/revocation must be checked against platform-owned time/state. Production receipts may remain historical rollback evidence across later epochs if their signature is valid.
